subjects.title: Maths
subjects.framework: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics

units.title: Ratios
goals: Describe how two amounts compare with a ratio
Make tables of equal ratios

units.title: Rates and unit rates
goals: Find unit rates like blocks per minute
Solve rate and speed problems

units.title: Percent
goals: Find a percent of a number
Find the whole from a part and a percent

units.title: Converting with ratios
goals: Use ratios to convert measurement units

units.title: Dividing fractions
goals: Divide fractions by fractions and explain it with models and stories

units.title: Multi-digit and decimal operations
goals: Divide multi-digit numbers the standard way
Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimals fluently

units.title: Common factors and multiples
goals: Find the greatest common factor and the least common multiple
Use the distributive property to factor a sum

units.title: Negative numbers
goals: Use negative numbers for temperatures, heights and amounts owed
Order numbers and find absolute values

units.title: The coordinate plane
goals: Plot points in all four quadrants
Find distances between points with the same x or the same y

units.title: Exponents and expressions
goals: Work out whole-number exponents
Write and work out expressions with letters

units.title: Equivalent expressions
goals: Use the properties of operations to write equivalent expressions

units.title: Equations and inequalities
goals: Solve one-step equations like x + 7 = 12 and 3x = 21
Write inequalities like x > 5 and show them on a number line

units.title: Variables that change together
goals: Use tables, graphs and equations to show how one amount depends on another

units.title: Area of triangles and polygons
goals: Find the area of triangles, parallelograms, trapezoids and other polygons

units.title: Volume and surface area
goals: Find the volume of boxes with fraction edges
Use nets to find surface area

units.title: Statistics: centre and spread
goals: Tell statistical questions from other questions
Find the mean, median, range and interquartile range

units.title: Dot plots, histograms and box plots
goals: Show data in dot plots, histograms and box plots, and read them

units.title: Problem-solving toolkit
standards: SG P6 heuristics (problem solving at the centre of the maths framework)
goals: Choose a strategy: draw a model, work backwards, make a list, guess and check, look for a pattern
Explain why a strategy worked

units.title: Cells: the building blocks of life
goals: Explain that living things are made of cells
Describe what the parts of a cell do

units.title: Body systems
goals: Explain how the body is made of systems of cells, tissues and organs that work together

units.title: Skeleton and muscles
standards: UK KS3 skeletal and muscular systems
goals: Explain how bones support and protect
Explain how muscles work in pairs

units.title: Nutrition and digestion
goals: Name the nutrients and a balanced diet
Explain how enzymes break food down

units.title: Senses and memory
goals: Explain how sense receptors send messages to the brain

units.title: Classifying life
goals: Sort living things into vertebrates and invertebrates and into kingdoms
Explain why scientists classify

units.title: Light travels
goals: Explain that light travels in straight lines
Explain how we see and how shadows take their shape

units.title: Heat and temperature
goals: Explain the difference between heat and temperature
Design a device that keeps heat in or out

units.title: Energy transfer
goals: Explain that when energy is transferred, the kinetic energy of objects changes

units.title: Energy changes
goals: Follow energy as it changes from one form to another (chemical to movement, electrical to light)
Find ways to waste less

units.title: The water cycle
goals: Describe how water moves through the water cycle, driven by the Sun and gravity

units.title: Weather
goals: Explain how air masses meeting make the weather

units.title: Climate
goals: Explain how sunlight, oceans and winds make climates
Explain what is making Earth's temperature rise

units.title: Plate tectonics
goals: Explain how moving plates build mountains and move continents

units.title: Forecasting natural hazards
goals: Use data to forecast natural hazards and reduce their harm

units.title: People and the environment
goals: Design ways to lower people's impact on the environment

units.title: Engineering design
goals: Write a design problem with criteria and limits
Test designs, compare the data and improve the best

units.title: Read closely and compare
goals: Cite evidence for what a text says and what you infer
Compare how a story and a fact text treat the same topic

units.title: Central idea and summary
goals: Find the central idea of a text and write a summary without opinions

units.title: Plot and character
goals: Describe how a plot unfolds and how characters change

units.title: Claims and evidence
goals: Tell which claims are supported by reasons and evidence

units.title: The author's point of view
goals: Explain an author's point of view and how it is shown

units.title: Poetry and sound
goals: Explain how word choice and sound affect meaning and tone

units.title: Pronouns
goals: Use the right pronoun case: I or me
Use intensive pronouns like myself
Fix unclear pronouns

units.title: Commas, brackets and dashes
goals: Set off extra information with commas, brackets or dashes

units.title: Sentence variety
goals: Vary sentence patterns to make writing interesting

units.title: Greek and Latin affixes and roots
goals: Use affixes and roots like audi (hear) to understand words

units.title: Personification and figures of speech
goals: Explain personification and other figures of speech

units.title: Word relationships
goals: Use relationships like cause and effect, and part and whole, to understand words

units.title: Connotation
goals: Tell the feeling a word carries, like stingy or thrifty

units.title: Write an argument
goals: Make a claim
Back it with reasons and evidence
Keep a formal style and a clear conclusion

units.title: Write to inform
goals: Organise ideas with definitions, examples and headings
Use precise words

units.title: Write a narrative
goals: Hook the reader
Build tension with pacing and dialogue
Use exact, vivid words

units.title: Research and sources
goals: Gather information from several sources
Put it in your own words
List your sources

units.title: Discuss and present
goals: Take part in a discussion and build on others' ideas
Present a claim with evidence and a picture or chart

subjects.title: History
subjects.framework: England's National Curriculum (KS2-KS3) with California world history, Cambridge Humanities and C3

units.title: After Rome
goals: Explain how the Roman Empire split
Describe Byzantium and Constantinople

units.title: Anglo-Saxons and Vikings
standards: UK KS2 (Anglo-Saxons and Scots, the Viking and Anglo-Saxon struggle)
goals: Describe settlers, raiders and traders
Explain Alfred the Great's kingdom
units.hard: Viking raids, the battle of Hastings

units.title: Baghdad and the House of Wisdom
standards: UK KS2 non-European society (early Islamic civilisation)
goals: Describe the scholars of Baghdad around AD 900
Name ideas from that time we still use (algebra, medicine, astronomy)
units.hard: the Mongol attack on Baghdad in 1258

units.title: Castles and medieval life
goals: Describe the Norman Conquest and castles
Describe life in villages, towns and guilds

units.title: Magna Carta and the first parliaments
goals: Explain how Magna Carta limited a ruler's power
Describe the start of Parliament

units.title: Inventions of Tang and Song China
goals: Describe printing, the compass, paper money and fireworks

units.title: Great African kingdoms
goals: Describe Mali and Mansa Musa
Benin's bronzes
The stone city of Great Zimbabwe
units.hard: the British attack on Benin in 1897

units.title: Medieval Japan
goals: Describe emperors, shoguns and samurai
Describe arts such as calligraphy and gardens

units.title: Aztecs and Incas
goals: Describe Tenochtitlan's floating gardens
Describe Inca roads and knotted-string records (quipu)

units.title: The Black Death and change
standards: UK KS3 (the Black Death, the Peasants' Revolt)
goals: Explain how a disease spread and changed work and life (causes and changes, no gruesome detail)

Say why some places are crowded and others empty

units.title: People on the move

units.title: Cities

Explain how economies change

Use six-figure grid references and scale

units.title: Weather and climate graphs
goals: Read a climate graph
Explain why climates differ

units.title: River processes

Describe meanders, waterfalls and floods

units.title: Africa
goals: Describe Africa's physical and human geography
Study one region

units.title: Asia
standards: UK KS3 (Asia, including China and India)
goals: Describe mountains, monsoons and megacities
Study China and India

units.title: Maps with layers (GIS)

Explain the three jobs of government (make, carry out and judge laws)

units.title: Disagreeing well

Change your mind when the evidence is better

units.title: Risk and protection
